messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: service=inference-eu-prod severity=high — multiple 5xx + latency spikes detected. Alert link: https://pd.example/alerts/ABCD1234

sara: ack — sara (oncall) here. I'm looking. tagging @aj for infra help. Noted customer impact: some EU customers seeing 10-30s tails and 500s.

aj: joining. grabbing logs + metrics now. which model/pool is affected?

kwok: looks like embeddings & chat routes hitting the eu shared pool. autoscaler stuck at min replicas (2) despite CPU/GPU queue growth. KV cache miss rate jumped to 45%.

ops-runbook: runbook snippet — follow these if autoscaler isn't reacting:
```bash
# scale runtime pool immediately
kubectl -n inference-prod scale deployment inference-runtime-eu --replicas=6
# route a portion of traffic to dedicated pool fallback
curl -X POST "https://console.internal/api/routing/override" -d '{"service":"inference-eu-prod","weight":{"dedicated-eu":0.3}}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

sara: executing scale now. will also open bridge.

aj: tailing logs — seeing repeated OOMs on worker-3 and request queue growing. pushing a hotfix to lower batch size and enable quantized variant for chat-small.

kwok: applied routing override 30% to dedicated-eu and bumped replicas to 6. Also toggled prefix/KV cache sticky mode.

pagerbot: Update: Alert suppressed for error-rate after scale (was firing every ~30s).

aj: hotfix deployed: `inference-config: batch_size=8 -> 4`, model_fallback=chat-small-quant-8bit. Instruments show p99 latency dropping.

sara: quick customer impact note for docs: ~1.8% of requests in EU had >10s latency or 5xx during spike window (start 2670012345). Affected sessions ~120 across 18 tenants. No data loss reported.

kwok: will monitor KV cache warmup; expect steady state in ~10-15m. If we see re-escalation, we'll open an eng-runtime bridge.

aj: verifying metrics: p95 back to normal, p99 improved ~65%. keeping increased capacity for 30m then evaluate.

ops-runbook: created incident bridge: https://zoom.internal/bridges/incident-2670012345 and added as a runbook task to redact sensitive logs for postmortem.

sara: thanks all. leaving note: will handoff to day oncall if stable in 20m, else keep monitoring. Closing thread here once we hit 30m steady. :thumbsup:
